title: Getting started with GateLabR
text: GateLabR opens R object, FCS files: SingleCellExperiment flowWorkspace GatingSet. Pass object, call launchGatingApp() argument pick SCEs session. CyTOF SingleCellExperiment comes CATALYST’s prepData(). FCS files flow cytometer assembled either object flowCore flowWorkspace: GatingSet, hierarchy holds opens app’s gates, drawn transformed space object evaluates , “Save GatingSet” writes populations back hierarchy place (see ?launchReactGateLab). SCE, flow data drawn per-channel logicle fluorescence linear scatter (editable W cofactor); CyTOF uses arcsinh (cofactor 5).
code: launchGatingApp(my_sce)          # a SingleCellExperiment launchGatingApp(my_gs)           # a flowWorkspace GatingSet launchGatingApp()                # pick from the SCEs in your session library(flowCore) library(flowWorkspace) fs <- read.flowSet(path = "fcs/", pattern = "\\.fcs$", truncate_max_range = FALSE)  # A GatingSet keeps the files' events on disk, compensated and transformed in place. # Compensate before transforming: a GatingSet cannot be uncompensated. gs <- GatingSet(fs) compensate(gs, spillover(fs[[1]])$SPILL)                # the matrix the files record fluor <- grep("-A$", colnames(gs), value = TRUE) fluor <- setdiff(fluor, grep("^(FSC|SSC)", fluor, value = TRUE)) transform(gs, estimateLogicle(gs[[1]], fluor))          # logicle per channel, W from the data launchGatingApp(gs)  # A SingleCellExperiment holds the events as columns and the channels as rows. Keep the # uncompensated values as `counts`; GateLabR compensates in the app and stores the result as # a second assay. library(SingleCellExperiment) events <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(fs), function(i) exprs(fs[[i]]))) sample_id <- rep(sampleNames(fs), fsApply(fs, nrow)) sce <- SingleCellExperiment(   assays = list(counts = t(events)),   colData = DataFrame(sample_id = sample_id),   rowData = DataFrame(channel_name = colnames(events),                       marker_name = unname(markernames(fs[[1]])[colnames(events)])) ) metadata(sce)$spillover <- spillover(fs[[1]])$SPILL     # offered in the Compensation tab launchGatingApp(sce)
